backfill_algorithm_design.owner_gate: OWNER_IDENTITY_FOUNDATION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED = YES — no mint begins until the owner ratifies the identity model, namespace, canonicalisation ADR, genesis key spec, registry contract, new-record policy, and the SGF source-tree freeze artifact.
backfill_algorithm_design.step_1_input_validation: sha256(questions.json) == GENESIS_SNAPSHOT_SHA256 exactly; record_count == 42804; the live SGF tree reproduces SGF_SOURCE_TREE_GENESIS_MANIFEST exactly (GENESIS_INPUT_EXACT_MATCH). Any mismatch -> STOP, mint nothing.
backfill_algorithm_design.step_2_manifest_build: canonicalise every source; fail closed on any SOURCE_NOT_RECOVERABLE; mint the genesis UUID for each; assert 42804 distinct UUIDs (collision detection) -> abort on collision.
backfill_algorithm_design.step_3_existing_uuid_detection: for each record consult the registry via the resolver; EXACT match to the proposed UUID -> skip (idempotent); a DIFFERENT existing uuid -> STOP (drift), human.
backfill_algorithm_design.step_4_dry_run: emit the full plan (N to mint / 0 to change / M already present) with per-record before/after; NO writes.
backfill_algorithm_design.step_5_apply: OWNER-GATED, separate step (NOT LC011): insert-only into the registry; write source_record_uuid into a NEW canonical read-model (NOT questions.json — that stays the frozen genesis input); append a GENESIS lineage marker per record.
backfill_algorithm_design.step_6_idempotent_rerun: same frozen input -> step 3 finds all present -> 0 mint, 0 change.
backfill_algorithm_design.step_7_rollback_recovery: registry is additive/insert-only; rollback = drop the read-model overlay; rows from a failed run are identifiable by minted_batch_id and are TOMBSTONED (never hard-deleted) by an owner-gated recovery step.

canonicalisation_rules.case_policy: PRESERVE (source FS case-sensitivity unproven; never casefold)
canonicalisation_rules.collection_name_policy: first path segment; preserved verbatim under the global rules
canonicalisation_rules.file_extension_policy: the check is a LITERAL '.sgf' suffix test (no splitext / last-dot). kept verbatim; '.SGF' -> fail closed. 327 folder segments contain '.' (chapter prefixes / 'Vol. 2') and are preserved (LC11-A).
canonicalisation_rules.reject_control_chars: any C0/C1 control, BOM, or the field separator -> SOURCE_NOT_RECOVERABLE
canonicalisation_rules.reject_segments: empty, '.', '..', or ending in ' ' or '.'  -> SOURCE_NOT_RECOVERABLE (fail closed)
canonicalisation_rules.relative_root_policy: collection-relative; the SGF題庫 tree root is NOT in the key (pinned separately by SGF_SOURCE_TREE_GENESIS_MANIFEST)
canonicalisation_rules.whitespace: whole-string leading/trailing stripped; internal preserved verbatim

dual_id_migration_window.admin_tools: key edits by source_record_uuid where present; the 11 legacy-collision groups are editable ONLY via source_record_uuid or the (record_index, legacy_question_id) audit locator
dual_id_migration_window.api_serialization: emit both source_record_uuid (or null) and question_id; question_id is non-unique
dual_id_migration_window.logging: log source_record_uuid where present, else legacy_question_id + canonical_identity_missing=true
dual_id_migration_window.read_authority: the canonical read-model; source_record_uuid preferred, legacy_question_id as a labelled alias
dual_id_migration_window.test_fixtures: may carry a clearly-fake PROTOTYPE_ONLY source_record_uuid or none
dual_id_migration_window.write_authority: the offline genesis backfill + the future authoring flow are the ONLY writers of source_record_uuid; nothing at request time

genesis_bootstrap_once_only: the snapshot SHA is NOT in the UUIDv5 name; it is immutable registry provenance + a hard once-only gate (a second genesis bootstrap against a different corpus/snapshot is REFUSED, not silently reassigned) — LC11-A

genesis_name_option: C — namespace + 'sgf-source-file' + 'v1' + canonical_source (NO snapshot sha in the name)

lifecycle_states.ACTIVE: well-formed identity in use; the ONLY state runtime may consume as canonical identity
lifecycle_states.AMBIGUOUS: resolver could not uniquely resolve; runtime MUST fall back to compatibility mode
lifecycle_states.NEEDS_REVIEW: queued for MANUAL_IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION; not consumable as identity
lifecycle_states.RETIRED: deleted / split-parent / merge-loser; audit only; runtime treats as canonical_identity_missing
lifecycle_states.SOURCE_MISSING: source file absent (delete pending restore); identity preserved; runtime = compatibility mode

lineage_event_fields.occurred_at: OPTIONAL (caller-supplied ISO string; never generated in tooling)
lineage_event_fields.sequence: AUTHORITY (monotonic per registry; ordering, not wall-clock)
lineage_event_fields.source_record_uuid: AUTHORITY (subject identity; null for split/merge which use parent/child)

new_record_identity_policy.hybrid_note: historical external-SGF records use UUIDv5 genesis; new native records use UUIDv4. Both obey one registry contract: mint once, persist, never recompute, resolver+lineage carry forward. A consumer must treat the UUID as opaque and MUST NOT branch on uuid.version.
new_record_identity_policy.mechanism: the authoring flow mints ONE random UUIDv4, writes it to the registry (mint_method=NEW_RECORD_UUIDV4, created_identity_kind=NEW_NATIVE, genesis_*=null) and persists it on the record. Never recomputed. Never request-time regenerated.
new_record_identity_policy.new_native_storage_requirement: a v4 exists only in the registry (unlike a v5, which is recomputable), so the identity registry + lineage MUST be append-only and replicated storage.
new_record_identity_policy.rejected_alternative: UUIDv5(author + counter + content_sha256) — none of those is a stable SOURCE ENTITY (author can be wrong, counter is an allocation-order = record_index analog, content can change).
new_record_identity_policy.v4_to_v5_upgrade_forbidden: if a NEW_NATIVE record later acquires a real `source`, the source becomes a current_source_alias — it NEVER triggers a re-mint to a v5. The v4 is permanent.
new_record_identity_policy.when: at authoritative creation of a hand-authored canonical question (source == '')

resolver_priority_ladder.evidence: incoming canonical_source == a record's current OR historical alias (exactly 1 ACTIVE) AND incoming content matches genesis_content_sha256 (or no content supplied)
same alias match, content CHANGED, a CONTENT_CORRECTION lineage event exists for it
same alias match, content CHANGED, NO correction event
resolver_priority_ladder.note: content-correction vs 'different puzzle at same filename' — human decides
registry integrity error — fail closed, human

resolver_priority_ladder.evidence: genesis_source_canonical AND genesis_content_sha256 both match (exactly 1; retired incl. -> restore)
content_sha256 matches exactly 1 ACTIVE record, no path relationship
content_sha256 shared by >1 ACTIVE record (the 404 duplicate groups)
legacy_question_id maps to exactly 1 ACTIVE record
legacy_question_id maps to >1 ACTIVE record (the 11 collision groups)

resolver_priority_ladder.note: mint a NEW identity — correct for a genuinely new source file

runtime_contract.consumes: source_record_uuid from the canonical persisted read-model, identity_status == ACTIVE only
runtime_contract.migration_fallback: if source_record_uuid absent -> use legacy_question_id as a LABELLED non-canonical compatibility key and emit canonical_identity_missing=true (mirrors the LC003/LC004 canonical_puzzle_id=null / invalid_identity=true pattern)
must_not: inspect a filesystem path to mint identity
fall back to content_sha256 as identity

sgf_source_tree_genesis_manifest_contrac.gate: the backfill refuses to run unless the live tree reproduces this manifest exactly
sgf_source_tree_genesis_manifest_contrac.purpose: pin the external SGF題庫 tree so a genesis backfill is reproducible and drift is detectable
sgf_source_tree_genesis_manifest_contrac.status: CONTRACT ONLY — LC011 cannot BUILD it (the SGF tree is external / not present); producing it is a gated prerequisite step before any backfill
sgf_source_tree_genesis_manifest_contrac.storage: checked into the repo as a path+hash list (a few MB) OR a hashed/compressed form; the raw SGF corpus is NOT copied into the repo unless separately authorized
tree_level: tree_manifest_sha256 (sha256 of the canonically-sorted manifest body)

canonicalisation_rule_change.how: CANONICALISATION_RULE_CHANGE event; a new canon-source-vN; genesis UUIDs are NEVER re-minted — the registry maps old canonical key -> uuid

case_only_rename.how: SOURCE_CASE_ONLY_RENAME event; case is preserved in the alias, UUID unchanged

collection_rename.how: SOURCE_COLLECTION_RENAME event; every affected record's alias rewritten; UUIDs unchanged

content_correction_same_entity.how: CONTENT_CORRECTION event attested by OWNER_REVIEW; resolver rank 4

delete_then_restore.how: DELETE -> RETIRED; RESTORE reactivates the SAME uuid only if the resolver returns EXACT/HIGH_CONFIDENCE; weak evidence -> new mint; never a request-time fresh UUID

different_puzzle_same_filename.how: SOURCE_REPLACED event; old identity RETIRED or moved; new file gets a MISSING -> new mint; resolver fails closed (AMBIGUOUS) without an explicit event

merge_many_to_one.how: one survivor kept; others RETIRED with superseded_by_uuid = survivor; all histories preserved

reimport_identical_frozen_corpus.how: genesis key = f(canonical_source) re-derives identically (Option C); the GENESIS_BOOTSTRAP_ONCE_ONLY gate then refuses a second write — the re-derive is for audit/recovery only

reimport_under_new_snapshot_sha.how: a second genesis bootstrap is REFUSED by the once-only gate; the new corpus's records go through the resolver (current alias / genesis source+content) -> same uuid for the same entity, MANUAL_IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION for anything ambiguous, a new mint only for a genuinely new file

rename_only.how: registry rename_or_move; old path -> historical_source_aliases; UUID never recomputed

split_one_to_many.how: parent RETIRED (reason SPLIT); each child gets a fresh identity; parent kept for audit; child.lineage_parent_uuids = [parent]
